rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule
rows.description: The land of the Zora, known as Zora's Domain, is home to the Champion Mipha and the guardians of the Great Spring. We have a long history of cultural exchange with them, dating back even further than ten thousand years ago. This promenade is a testament to that long standing relationship between the Zora and Hyrule.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule Castle
rows.description: Hyrule Castle was here on the Great Plateau in ancient times and is still under the protection of the kingdom. Father has decreed that the people are free to worship at the Temple of Time. Barring that, however, only the royal family may enter here. I imagine that is because the royal family still has many connections to this area.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule Castle
rows.description: I've always wanted to investigate the Hebra Mountains up close. It appears the mountainside has been scarred by an energy blast. Naturally, I would think this scarring was a direct result of the Calamity ten thousands years ago. But were that the case... Hmm... From what I can tell by looking at it, it would seem the mountain was blasted from the direction of Hyrule Castle... I find this unsettling.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule Castle Gate
rows.description: I understand that the gates of Hyrule Castle are being built in preparation for the Calamity. At the moment, Sheikah researchers and skilled Goron blacksmiths are working together and have gathered within the castle walls. It's clear to me that Father is taking the threat of the Calamity seriously.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule Castle Gazebo
rows.description: Among the many overlooks, this is my favorite. I remember spending time with Mother here. Back then, Father still laughed—frequently... I wonder if the day will come when we can laugh together like that again.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule Cathedral
rows.description: Hyrule Cathedral... When I was small, I used to imitate how Mother prayed when she came here. I should have watched her more closely... Or, no. Perhaps instead, I must find my own prayer.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule Forest Park
rows.description: It is said that Hyrule Forest Park began with a single tree planted by the first king and queen of Hyrule. Since then, a tree has been planted each time the throne is succeeded, and now they make up this thriving woodland.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule Garrison
rows.description: In addition to protecting the castle, it has become necessary to deploy our soldiers all across Hyrule. Outpost ruins are being temporarily used as military bases. The fountain at the center of Hyrule Garrison looks quite out of place, but it serves as an area of respite for the soldiers.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule Garrison Ruins
rows.description: In addition to protecting the castle, it has become necessary to deploy our soldiers all across Hyrule. Outpost ruins are being temporarily used as military bases. The fountain at the center of Hyrule Garrison looks quite out of place, but it serves as an area of respite for the soldiers.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule Kingdom
rows.description: The land of the Zora, known as Zora's Domain, is home to the Champion Mipha and the guardians of the Great Spring. We have a long history of cultural exchange with them, dating back even further than ten thousand years ago. This promenade is a testament to that long standing relationship between the Zora and Hyrule.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Hyrule Outpost
rows.description: This is Hyrule's largest outpost, but it had humble beginnings as an encampment for travelers on a spiritual journey. Recently, a garrison was completed nearby, so the outpost now seems to serve as a place for soldiers to rest after long days—its watchtower apparently a gift from them.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Impa
rows.description: Impa will be the next elder. I am thrilled to see her take up the mantle. At present, she is the royal advisor, however, and is responsible for the internal investigation of the Divine Beasts. As such, she implored the current elder to wait until her work with the investigation is complete, after which she will officially step into her new role.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Impa
rows.description: The people of Kakariko Village cherish plum trees as a symbol of Sheikah history. Rejoicing that a dear friend had been blessed with a baby, Impa planted one such tree and ended up covered in mud in the process. It was her wish that her friend's child would end up healthy and happy.

rows.subject: Island Lobster Shirt
rows.description: The Hero of Winds once wore this shirt on the quaint island he called home. They say he wielded the wind to travel the ocean wide. It's a rather rare find.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Kakariko Village
rows.description: For generations, the Sheikah have lived in Kakariko Village. The town has been their refuge ever since they were banished from Hyrule—their advanced technology was viewed as a threat. The village itself is nestled in the mountains, as an intentional hiding place. I imagine it feels as a haven to them...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Kakariko Village
rows.description: Impa will be the next elder. I am thrilled to see her take up the mantle. At present, she is the royal advisor, however, and is responsible for the internal investigation of the Divine Beasts. As such, she implored the current elder to wait until her work with the investigation is complete, after which she will officially step into her new role.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Kakariko Village
rows.description: The people of Kakariko Village cherish plum trees as a symbol of Sheikah history. Rejoicing that a dear friend had been blessed with a baby, Impa planted one such tree and ended up covered in mud in the process. It was her wish that her friend's child would end up healthy and happy.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Kakariko Village
rows.description: Cotera is worshipped as the goddess of the land, and the villagers' offerings to her tend to be vegetables rather than rupees. It sounds like she's been less lively due to a decrease in rupee donations lately. Self-sufficiency is taking root in Kakariko Village, so perhaps fewer people see the value in rupees...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Kara Kara Bazaar
rows.description: Kara Kara Bazaar serves as a trading post for those who cannot enter Gerudo Town. It's a smart thing, since the town only allows women to enter. Urbosa warned me to be on alert for the Yiga Clan here, but I cannot imagine they would attack in a place as crowded as this. She worries a bit too much.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Ketoh Wawai Shrine
rows.description: The existence of a shrine has been confirmed here at Thyphlo Ruins. Could that darkness act as a test to the one chosen by the sword that seals the darkness? I don't think I can go much farther, however. I wonder if I will have to ask him to come investigate? No, I don't want to have to rely on him for this.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King Dorephan
rows.description: These stone monuments erected along this path detail the history of the Zora in King Dorephan's words. Thus far, only three have been made, but once the rest are completed, travelers will be able to learn even more about the Zora.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King Dorephan
rows.description: King Dorephan rules over the Zora and is father to Mipha. He's known for his incredible strength—in fact, he fights with his fins rather than wielding a weapon. One of the guards here even told me excitedly about an army of monsters who were eradicated with a single blow from the king.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King Dorephan
rows.description: This depiction of Mipha is truly exquisite, though that is hardly surprising—Zora's Domain is home to talented metalworking artisans, after all. It is said that this statue was made not only to honor her elevation as a Champion, but also to act as a beacon for her safety, in the hopes that she will return home. She was embarrassed by it, however, and has asked King Dorephan to move it somewhere less prominent once she completes her duty.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King Rhoam
rows.description: Trade with Gerudo Town is going well, but apparently there is no end to the traveling merchants meeting with disaster in the canyon. Though the Gerudo may be accustomed to the road, it is a difficult one for Hylians. I'll speak with Father about whether we can have a stable built here.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King Rhoam
rows.subjectDisplayName: The Knight Who Wields the Fated Sword
rows.description: When I heard Father announce that the knight chosen by the sword that seals the darkness was Link, I felt anything but calm inside. Whenever I hear that name, an anxiousness sets in. Even more challenging are my feelings of envy toward him... I wonder if there will ever be a day when I can look him in the eyes...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King Rhoam
rows.description: Hyrule Castle was here on the Great Plateau in ancient times and is still under the protection of the kingdom. Father has decreed that the people are free to worship at the Temple of Time. Barring that, however, only the royal family may enter here. I imagine that is because the royal family still has many connections to this area.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King Rhoam
rows.description: From here, you can see the Great Plateau—or rather, Hyrule itself. At the castle, we are king and princess, but while here, we were father and daughter. It was in this place that I learned about everything from paragliders to cooking... I still remember the feeling of the warm doublet Father wrapped around my shoulders...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King Rhoam
rows.description: Ah, the observation room. Father would often stand here, looking with kind eyes down upon the bustling town below. I recall him saying, "One cannot rule a country without knowing its people."

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King Rhoam
rows.description: Among the many overlooks, this is my favorite. I remember spending time with Mother here. Back then, Father still laughed—frequently... I wonder if the day will come when we can laugh together like that again.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King of Hyrule
rows.description: Divine Beast Vah Ruta is named after the Zora sage. I wonder if it was submerged in water by the king of Hyrule when the reservoir was made. In any case, I have heard that its trunk, capable of releasing vast amounts of water, lowered when Mipha approached—a clear invitation for her, almost as though it was an old friend.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King of Hyrule
rows.description: Many ancient relics of the Sheikah were considered dangerous and were therefore entombed in darkness by the king of Hyrule long ago... In particular, the Shrine of Resurrection was considered especially dangerous, as it controls people's fates. It was kept under close watch by the royal family. Now that recent investigations into the Divine Beasts have revealed that this shrine was built in preparation against the Calamity, however, we should move forward with its study.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: King's Tomb
rows.description: From here, you can see the Great Plateau—or rather, Hyrule itself. At the castle, we are king and princess, but while here, we were father and daughter. It was in this place that I learned about everything from paragliders to cooking... I still remember the feeling of the warm doublet Father wrapped around my shoulders...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Kochi Dye Shop
rows.description: The Kochi Dye Shop is considered without peer all across Hyrule. The owner, too, is without peer... I brought five garments here to have them dyed using the shop's special technique, and a unique royal-blue color was achieved by taking extracts from a silent princess. I wonder if everyone will appreciate them.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Korgu Chideh
rows.description: I convinced a fisher from Lurelin Village to take me to Eventide Island by boat. I've heard this island served as a final training ground for monks. I wonder what kind of rigorous trial awaited them here. Now, however, the island is overrun by monsters—I had no choice but to abandon going ashore...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Korgu Chideh Shrine
rows.description: I convinced a fisher from Lurelin Village to take me to Eventide Island by boat. I've heard this island served as a final training ground for monks. I wonder what kind of rigorous trial awaited them here. Now, however, the island is overrun by monsters—I had no choice but to abandon going ashore...

rows.subject: Korok Mask
rows.description: A mask inspired by those fun-loving Koroks. It shakes when one is hiding nearby. It's a rather rare find.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lake Hylia
rows.description: Deya Lake is artificially created. It is said that long, long ago there was a great drought that threatened to dry up Lake Hylia, so Deya Lake was created as a reservoir, just in case. The name Deya stems from the name of the village that the lake has flooded.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lakeside Stable
rows.description: Here at Lakeside Stable, the jungle is dense, and much of the land remains undeveloped. I'm confident that there are many new discoveries to be made in such a place. There are even rumors of an unidentified creature of some sort, but I hear the harsh weather conditions are such a deterrent that even researchers keen to learn more hesitate to travel here.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lanayru Wetlands
rows.description: Here in Goponga Village, they're working to make it possible to manage horses with just a few people. This would be achievable by using the small islands scattered about Lanayru Wetlands as stables. There's a grassy field at the village's entrance where the horses seem to be living at ease. And the villagers here even told me my white horse is beautiful.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lantern Falls
rows.description: The researchers here are hard at work raising ornamental carp. They were inspired when they saw a beautiful fish called the mighty porgy that lives in the sea to the south. They tell me they're breeding rare carp that were born with mutations.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lantern Lake
rows.description: The researchers here are hard at work raising ornamental carp. They were inspired when they saw a beautiful fish called the mighty porgy that lives in the sea to the south. They tell me they're breeding rare carp that were born with mutations.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lava
rows.description: Just beyond the Maw of Death Mountain is a scorching region. The heat from the flow of lava can be intense—so intense, in fact, that it can take one's life should they fail to prepare accordingly. My bodyguards forbade me from going any farther, yet it is my duty to keep a close watch on the Divine Beasts we will be fighting alongside. This mission proves to be exceedingly dangerous...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Library
rows.description: Books from all around Hyrule live here in this library. As such, it is a critical place for conducting research, but Father has forbidden entry. Guards are on constant watch just outside the entrance, so for now, it's better to enter using the hidden passage from the docks.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Link
rows.description: This is a sacred place. Once, Daruk suggested I re-create a ceremony believed to have been held here in the past, the knighting ceremony for the one wielding the sword that seals the darkness. It...did not go well. Urbosa tells me I should look the knight in the eye rather than looking at the sword, but whenever I try, I simply...can't.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Link
rows.subjectDisplayName: The Knight Who Wields the Fated Sword
rows.description: When I heard Father announce that the knight chosen by the sword that seals the darkness was Link, I felt anything but calm inside. Whenever I hear that name, an anxiousness sets in. Even more challenging are my feelings of envy toward him... I wonder if there will ever be a day when I can look him in the eyes...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Link
rows.description: The Great Deku Tree watches over the sword that seals the darkness. I also view this tree as a mentor, in a sense. When the knight was chosen to wield the darkness-sealing sword, I felt nearly overcome by my feelings. But the Great Deku Tree offered me words of wisdom in that moment, encouraging me not to give up and that I had my own path to follow. Those words provide comfort to me still.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Link
rows.description: The Highland Stable. This area of vast green lands is home to people skilled in horse handling. Here, horseback archery is a popular pastime. Even Link has admiration for these people's talent in horsemanship.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Link
rows.description: The existence of a shrine has been confirmed here at Thyphlo Ruins. Could that darkness act as a test to the one chosen by the sword that seals the darkness? I don't think I can go much farther, however. I wonder if I will have to ask him to come investigate? No, I don't want to have to rely on him for this.

rows.subject: Lizalfos Mask
rows.description: Kilton's handmade Lizalfos headgear. It's designed to replicate the unique tongue and horn of the Lizalfos. Equip it to blend in with Lizalfos.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lockup
rows.description: If the sturdy iron bars are any indication, those who are brought to the lockup must've committed weighty crimes. I don't believe it's been in use for a very long time, so the guards who would normally stand post here have instead been sent to watch over the castle.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lomei Labyrinth Island
rows.description: It's called a lighthouse, but my understanding is that it was built as more of a watchtower. But to watch over what, I wonder. Beyond here lies Lomei Labyrinth Island, home to ancient ruins shrouded by mystery. Even approaching the ruins proves challenging. Some scholars posit that evil spirits are trapped there... Perhaps this lighthouse served to watch over the island? I'm probably overthinking it...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lord of the Mountain
rows.description: There are only two cherry blossom trees in Hyrule. They have been referred to as the Father Tree and Mother Tree. I imagine this is because the cherry blossom trees are sometimes worshipped for their supposed ability to purge evil spirits. Satori, who is said to live on this mountain, may be a protector of Mother Tree, sent by Father Tree.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lost Woods
rows.description: Great Hyrule Forest is a sacred place where spirits reside. Only by following the wind's guidance can a traveler make their way through. The guidance is only offered up to a chosen few by the spirits themselves. Those who do not receive this blessing of wind will quickly find that they are right back where they started. It's easy to see how this grove came to be called the Lost Woods.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lover's Pond
rows.description: Tuft Mountain is a destination for many mountaineers. It's also known as the matchmaking mountain. The custom is to climb in total silence, and upon reaching the top, pray as the sun dips below the horizon. I set out to climb the mountain myself, but I was stopped by Link who observed how very steep it is. Personally, I feel he was being overly cautious.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lucky Clover Gazette
rows.description: The proprietor was proud to tell me that, of all of them, Rito Stable boasts the oldest history. He also shared that no matter what price was offered, he would never sell it. His passion for this place will surely be carried on through his family line.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lucky Treasure Shop
rows.description: Occasionally while out fishing, the fishers will find treasure chests that have sunken to the ocean floor. They enjoy playing a game wherein they attempt to guess the chest's contents. Everyone who plays takes the game quite seriously, as the rules include that guessing correctly means that person keeps whatever is inside the chest.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lumber
rows.description: It tends to be their fabrics that garner attention, but the Rito have the best woodworking techniques in Hyrule, as well. From their serving dishes to their structures, even the very framework of their village, the Rito have made everything from wood. I'm told the way they transport lumber midair is quite the sight, and I'd love to see it someday.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lurelin Village
rows.description: The cove here in Lurelin Village is so lively with its many boats. Even before anyone recognized who I was, I was treated with hospitality and warmth. The villagers served me a dish with an exquisite, vibrantly colored fish. You cannot find such a fish anywhere around the castle. Everyone here is so cheerful and kind... Spending time among them, I was able to forget the current hardships, even if momentarily.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lurelin Village
rows.description: I'm told the houses of Lurelin Village were built by shipwrights, so they're as sturdy as ships. Perhaps that is a tradition among fishing villages. The head of the village told me, however, that there are fewer and fewer shipwrights these days, and it may be challenging to rebuild if the existing homes were destroyed.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lurelin Village
rows.description: Ah, the Goddess Statue of Lurelin Village. Here she is worshipped as the guardian of fishing—she has been enshrined in this location to keep watch over the docks. The villagers provide offerings of their catches each day. I noted a rather large pile of fresh fish and crabs placed at her feet.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lurelin Village
rows.description: Occasionally while out fishing, the fishers will find treasure chests that have sunken to the ocean floor. They enjoy playing a game wherein they attempt to guess the chest's contents. Everyone who plays takes the game quite seriously, as the rules include that guessing correctly means that person keeps whatever is inside the chest.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lurelin Village
rows.description: I convinced a fisher from Lurelin Village to take me to Eventide Island by boat. I've heard this island served as a final training ground for monks. I wonder what kind of rigorous trial awaited them here. Now, however, the island is overrun by monsters—I had no choice but to abandon going ashore...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Lynel
rows.description: The Zora use Shatterback Point as an area to demonstrate their courage. I understand this was once a crowded and lively place—many young people came to test their mettle. But ever since a Lynel took residence in the mountain, no one dares go near. No one except Sidon, I fear. Mipha expressly told him not to go, but he got a look in his eye when she did...

rows.subject: Lynel Mask
rows.description: Kilton's handmade Lynel headgear. It's so well crafted, it can deceive a real Lynel. Equip it to blend in with Lynels, but don't linger too long. Those beasts are smart.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mabe Village
rows.description: Mabe Village boasts the largest farm in all of Hyrule, with more animals than villagers. From making hay to processing milk, it's clear when something has come from Mabe Village, and the villagers take pride in that fact.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mabe Village Ruins
rows.description: Mabe Village boasts the largest farm in all of Hyrule, with more animals than villagers. From making hay to processing milk, it's clear when something has come from Mabe Village, and the villagers take pride in that fact.

rows.subject: Majora's Mask (Item)
rows.description: An eerie mask passed down from ancient times. Wearing it makes it harder for certain enemies to spot you. It's a rather rare find.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Malice
rows.description: I've heard stories that if you want to cut ties with someone or something, chanting their name while crossing through the middle of the pond will do precisely that. The pond's shape resembles a heart, and I wonder if the path in the center was created as more and more people walked it, compacting the soil. I hope that Malice never forms here.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Maritta Exchange
rows.description: With the Rito and Gerudo coming here to offer up specialty wares from across Hyrule, Maritta Exchange is always a lively place. In particular, the fish being sold here are popular among Rito and Gerudo alike—they sell out almost immediately.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Maritta Exchange Ruins
rows.description: With the Rito and Gerudo coming here to offer up specialty wares from across Hyrule, Maritta Exchange is always a lively place. In particular, the fish being sold here are popular among Rito and Gerudo alike—they sell out almost immediately.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Master Sword
rows.description: This is a sacred place. Once, Daruk suggested I re-create a ceremony believed to have been held here in the past, the knighting ceremony for the one wielding the sword that seals the darkness. It...did not go well. Urbosa tells me I should look the knight in the eye rather than looking at the sword, but whenever I try, I simply...can't.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Master Sword
rows.subjectDisplayName: The Knight Who Wields the Fated Sword
rows.description: When I heard Father announce that the knight chosen by the sword that seals the darkness was Link, I felt anything but calm inside. Whenever I hear that name, an anxiousness sets in. Even more challenging are my feelings of envy toward him... I wonder if there will ever be a day when I can look him in the eyes...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Master Sword
rows.description: The Great Deku Tree watches over the sword that seals the darkness. I also view this tree as a mentor, in a sense. When the knight was chosen to wield the darkness-sealing sword, I felt nearly overcome by my feelings. But the Great Deku Tree offered me words of wisdom in that moment, encouraging me not to give up and that I had my own path to follow. Those words provide comfort to me still.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Maw of Death Mountain
rows.description: Just beyond the Maw of Death Mountain is a scorching region. The heat from the flow of lava can be intense—so intense, in fact, that it can take one's life should they fail to prepare accordingly. My bodyguards forbade me from going any farther, yet it is my duty to keep a close watch on the Divine Beasts we will be fighting alongside. This mission proves to be exceedingly dangerous...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mellie
rows.description: The people of Kakariko Village cherish plum trees as a symbol of Sheikah history. Rejoicing that a dear friend had been blessed with a baby, Impa planted one such tree and ended up covered in mud in the process. It was her wish that her friend's child would end up healthy and happy.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mellie's Plum Garden
rows.description: The people of Kakariko Village cherish plum trees as a symbol of Sheikah history. Rejoicing that a dear friend had been blessed with a baby, Impa planted one such tree and ended up covered in mud in the process. It was her wish that her friend's child would end up healthy and happy.

rows.subject: Midna's Helmet
rows.description: A helmet much like the one Midna wore when she fought alongside the Hero of Twilight. It's a rather rare find.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mighty Porgy
rows.description: The researchers here are hard at work raising ornamental carp. They were inspired when they saw a beautiful fish called the mighty porgy that lives in the sea to the south. They tell me they're breeding rare carp that were born with mutations.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mighty Porgy
rows.description: The cove here in Lurelin Village is so lively with its many boats. Even before anyone recognized who I was, I was treated with hospitality and warmth. The villagers served me a dish with an exquisite, vibrantly colored fish. You cannot find such a fish anywhere around the castle. Everyone here is so cheerful and kind... Spending time among them, I was able to forget the current hardships, even if momentarily.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mipha
rows.description: Divine Beast Vah Ruta is named after the Zora sage. I wonder if it was submerged in water by the king of Hyrule when the reservoir was made. In any case, I have heard that its trunk, capable of releasing vast amounts of water, lowered when Mipha approached—a clear invitation for her, almost as though it was an old friend.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mipha
rows.description: The land of the Zora, known as Zora's Domain, is home to the Champion Mipha and the guardians of the Great Spring. We have a long history of cultural exchange with them, dating back even further than ten thousand years ago. This promenade is a testament to that long standing relationship between the Zora and Hyrule.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mipha
rows.description: King Dorephan rules over the Zora and is father to Mipha. He's known for his incredible strength—in fact, he fights with his fins rather than wielding a weapon. One of the guards here even told me excitedly about an army of monsters who were eradicated with a single blow from the king.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mipha
rows.description: This depiction of Mipha is truly exquisite, though that is hardly surprising—Zora's Domain is home to talented metalworking artisans, after all. It is said that this statue was made not only to honor her elevation as a Champion, but also to act as a beacon for her safety, in the hopes that she will return home. She was embarrassed by it, however, and has asked King Dorephan to move it somewhere less prominent once she completes her duty.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mipha
rows.description: The Zora use Shatterback Point as an area to demonstrate their courage. I understand this was once a crowded and lively place—many young people came to test their mettle. But ever since a Lynel took residence in the mountain, no one dares go near. No one except Sidon, I fear. Mipha expressly told him not to go, but he got a look in his eye when she did...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mipha's Champion Garb
rows.description: The Kochi Dye Shop is considered without peer all across Hyrule. The owner, too, is without peer... I brought five garments here to have them dyed using the shop's special technique, and a unique royal-blue color was achieved by taking extracts from a silent princess. I wonder if everyone will appreciate them.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mipha's Statue
rows.description: This depiction of Mipha is truly exquisite, though that is hardly surprising—Zora's Domain is home to talented metalworking artisans, after all. It is said that this statue was made not only to honor her elevation as a Champion, but also to act as a beacon for her safety, in the hopes that she will return home. She was embarrassed by it, however, and has asked King Dorephan to move it somewhere less prominent once she completes her duty.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Moat Bridge
rows.description: Beyond the moat bridge lies a prison where those who have committed grave crimes are sent. Ever since I was small, I have been forbidden to cross here.

rows.subject: Moblin Mask
rows.description: Kilton's handmade Moblin headgear. It's designed to replicate the Moblin's distinct long nose and large horn. Equip it to blend in with Moblins.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Molduga
rows.subjectDisplayName: All That Remains of Warriors' Dreams
rows.description: The North Gerudo Ruins are the largest in all of the desert. Based on the sizable quarry and numerous ruins scattered about Gerudo Highlands, it appears that Gerudo Town was once quite large. I've heard that this area of the town was destroyed by a rampaging Molduga employed by a tyrant. But it is merely a theory.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Monk
rows.description: I convinced a fisher from Lurelin Village to take me to Eventide Island by boat. I've heard this island served as a final training ground for monks. I wonder what kind of rigorous trial awaited them here. Now, however, the island is overrun by monsters—I had no choice but to abandon going ashore...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mother Goddess Statue
rows.description: These ruins are thought to date back to the kingdom's founding. It seems likely that something of great value was once here, as there are many Guardians in the area. Additionally, according to ancient documents, there was a room beyond the Goddess Statue, but it now appears to be buried in sediment.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mother Tree
rows.description: There are only two cherry blossom trees in Hyrule. They have been referred to as the Father Tree and Mother Tree. I imagine this is because the cherry blossom trees are sometimes worshipped for their supposed ability to purge evil spirits. Satori, who is said to live on this mountain, may be a protector of Mother Tree, sent by Father Tree.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mount Hylia
rows.description: Past this gate is a snowy landscape—cold enough for one to freeze there. The area is a place where heroes can test their skills, but the landscape is clearly not a natural phenomenon. Perhaps some ancient technology we have yet to learn about is being used here...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mount Hylia
rows.description: From here, you can see the Great Plateau—or rather, Hyrule itself. At the castle, we are king and princess, but while here, we were father and daughter. It was in this place that I learned about everything from paragliders to cooking... I still remember the feeling of the warm doublet Father wrapped around my shoulders...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mount Lanayru
rows.description: Purifier Lake is used for cleansing prior to visiting Mount Lanayru for worship. It is a very sacred place, so there are detailed steps which must be followed here. I cannot visit yet because I'm not old enough according to custom. That said, I have practiced the steps many times in preparation for when that time comes. I'm sure I will manage just fine... But perhaps I will practice just once more.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mount Lanayru
rows.description: This is the spring where Nayru, Goddess of Wisdom, is worshipped. "Those younger than 17 lack wisdom and are forbidden from entering the mountain." Hm. Today, all I can do is look up at it, but tomorrow, I climb Mount Lanayru. If my sealing power doesn't awaken... No...it will. I'm certain it will be fine.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Mount Lanayru
rows.description: I have come to this spring countless times since I was young to receive the protection of Farore, Goddess of Courage. Despite that, my sealing power has yet to be awakened... But soon I will turn 17. I'm certain that if I train on Mount Lanayru, that will change things...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Nayru
rows.description: This is the spring where Nayru, Goddess of Wisdom, is worshipped. "Those younger than 17 lack wisdom and are forbidden from entering the mountain." Hm. Today, all I can do is look up at it, but tomorrow, I climb Mount Lanayru. If my sealing power doesn't awaken... No...it will. I'm certain it will be fine.

rows.subject: Nintendo Switch Shirt
rows.description:
Expansion Pass Bonus
A shirt with the Nintendo Switch logo on it. It's a rather rare find, so wear it with pride!

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Noble Pursuit
rows.description: The Noble Canteen's famous cocktail is known as the Noble Pursuit. Gerudo preparing to seek the voe of their dreams drink it for good luck. I wanted to partake in one but was told that I'm not ready for it yet...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: North Gerudo Ruins
rows.subjectDisplayName: All That Remains of Warriors' Dreams
rows.description: The North Gerudo Ruins are the largest in all of the desert. Based on the sizable quarry and numerous ruins scattered about Gerudo Highlands, it appears that Gerudo Town was once quite large. I've heard that this area of the town was destroyed by a rampaging Molduga employed by a tyrant. But it is merely a theory.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Observation Room
rows.description: Ah, the observation room. Father would often stand here, looking with kind eyes down upon the bustling town below. I recall him saying, "One cannot rule a country without knowing its people."

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Old Man's Cabin
rows.description: There are many gaps in this mountain hut, and even the rope holding the logs together seems dubious... It is far too shabby for a hunter's cabin... I didn't enter—the hut seemed it may collapse at any moment, so I was unable to identify the owner. It should probably be dismantled before someone gets hurt.

rows.subject: Old Shirt
rows.description: A thin shirt made long ago. It's coming apart at the seams, but it's better than nothing. The sleeves are a bit on the short side.

rows.subject: Opal Earrings
rows.description: Earrings sold at Gerudo jewelry shops. They contain opal, a gem that harnesses the power of water to increase your swimming speed.

rows.subject: Opal Earrings
rows.description: Earrings containing opal, a gem that harnesses the power of water to increase your swimming speed. A Great Fairy has increased their defense by one level.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Ordorac Quarry
rows.description: This is the spring where Din, Goddess of Power, is worshipped. Once she was one of the Three Goddesses, alongside Courage and Wisdom, but it is said that faith in her dimmed due to power being seen as a symbol of the Demon King. The terrain around the spring is complex and covered with roughly chopped trees, suggesting this place was once used as a training site of some kind.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Outpost Ruins
rows.description: This is Hyrule's largest outpost, but it had humble beginnings as an encampment for travelers on a spiritual journey. Recently, a garrison was completed nearby, so the outpost now seems to serve as a place for soldiers to rest after long days—its watchtower apparently a gift from them.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Outskirt Stable
rows.description: Urbosa has requested the construction of a new stable. The Gerudo often leave the city to travel when they come of age, so she asked for the stable to be set up near the entrance to Gerudo Canyon so they can prepare for their journey. This seems like just the right location for such a place. Normally a stable is named after the area it's built upon, but this one sits upon a boundary... I wonder what it will be called.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Paraglider
rows.description: From here, you can see the Great Plateau—or rather, Hyrule itself. At the castle, we are king and princess, but while here, we were father and daughter. It was in this place that I learned about everything from paragliders to cooking... I still remember the feeling of the warm doublet Father wrapped around my shoulders...

rows.subject: Phantom Armor
rows.description: Myths abound about armored phantoms that terrorized brave heroes. This piece looks just like the armor they supposedly wore. It's a rather rare find.

rows.subject: Phantom Equipment
rows.description: Myths abound about armored phantoms that terrorized brave heroes. The crest of the Hyrule family is visible on the back, perhaps lending credibility to the ancient legend that tells of a princess of the royal family who once possessed these armored behemoths.

rows.subject: Phantom Ganon Armor
rows.description: Some believe this armor is inspirited by a dark entity resembling the Great King of Evil himself. It's a rather rare find.

rows.subject: Phantom Ganon Greaves
rows.description: Some believe these greaves are inspirited by a dark entity resembling the Great King of Evil himself. They're a rather rare find.

rows.subject: Phantom Ganon Set
rows.description: The Phantom Ganon armor is rumored to be possessed by a dark entity created by the Great King of Evil himself. The skull mask has a frightening look to it.

rows.subject: Phantom Ganon Skull
rows.description: Some believe this eerie headgear is inspirited by a dark entity resembling the Great King of Evil himself. It's a rather rare find.

rows.subject: Phantom Greaves

rows.subject: Phantom Helmet

rows.subject: Princess Ruto
rows.description: Divine Beast Vah Ruta is named after the Zora sage. I wonder if it was submerged in water by the king of Hyrule when the reservoir was made. In any case, I have heard that its trunk, capable of releasing vast amounts of water, lowered when Mipha approached—a clear invitation for her, almost as though it was an old friend.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Princess Zelda's Room
rows.description: Despite my lovely bed prepared for me here in my room, I cannot remember the last time I was able to sleep the night through. I suppose it's to be expected. If what was prophesizedshould be: prophesied [[wikipedia:Sic|''sic'']]This is not an error. This word was misspelled in the original source. holds true, there is little time left.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Princess Zelda's Study
rows.description: This place was originally used as a watchtower, but I've repurposed it into my own study. It's perfect for conducting my studies away from Father's prying eyes. At the moment, I'm learning about ancient relics as well as the preservation of endangered species.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Purah
rows.description: The mayor lamented struggling to find a buyer for this vacant home due to the distance from the village center. I do recall Purah wanting a place where she could devote herself to research without any prying eyes...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Purah
rows.description: It has been decided that we will investigate ancient Sheikah ruins in preparation for the Calamity. The entrance to the Royal Ancient Lab, which we were forbidden from opening, now stands open. Things such as blueprints still remain, and Purah and Robbie have been absorbed in reading them, sparing no time for sleep.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Purah
rows.description: At Purah's urging, South Akkala Stable was built. It seems she gave the stable owners many sheep to celebrate the opening, so now the grounds are filled with them. There are more sheep than there are horses here. I have to wonder...why sheep?

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Purifier Lake
rows.description: Purifier Lake is used for cleansing prior to visiting Mount Lanayru for worship. It is a very sacred place, so there are detailed steps which must be followed here. I cannot visit yet because I'm not old enough according to custom. That said, I have practiced the steps many times in preparation for when that time comes. I'm sure I will manage just fine... But perhaps I will practice just once more.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Queen of Hyrule
rows.subjectDisplayName: Those Who Reside in the Desert
rows.description: Here in Gerudo Desert, the temperatures vary wildly—enough so to be life threatening. In addition, traveling across the sand by foot is challenging. These conditions certainly explain the strength of body and spirit that the Gerudo possess. Which has me thinking... While Mother was prone to illness, she would often visit here, despite the harsh environment...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Queen of Hyrule
rows.description: This is the center of Castle Town, otherwise known as Central Square. The fountain area is crowded with people and vendors—it's always so lively. The mood and scents here sometimes cause a wave of nostalgia in me, reminding me of the flower crown Mother bought me here when I was little.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Queen of Hyrule
rows.description: Hyrule Cathedral... When I was small, I used to imitate how Mother prayed when she came here. I should have watched her more closely... Or, no. Perhaps instead, I must find my own prayer.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Queen of Hyrule
rows.description: Though it is small, this settlement is the oldest in the land. Named after the founding king of Hyrule, there are various theories regarding the specificity of that name. Some believe that it was the king's residence, others that it was a village of his most ardent supporters, and yet others claim it was the birthplace of the Hylian queen. Ultimately, I'm not sure even the villagers themselves know the true origins of the name.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Queen of Hyrule
rows.description: The proprietor of Woodland Stable was deeply moved by how beautifully ornamented Mother's horse was and is now studying techniques for adorning them himself. He even braided my horse's mane to match my own braids. Mother's care for horses lives on, in this way. It fills me with joy to see it.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Queen of Hyrule
rows.description: Royal princesses have a sacred power, which is claimed to have been passed down generation after generation. In fact, the lineage traces all the way back to the first queen, when Hyrule was founded. The ritual at the Temple of Time falls upon the princess to carry out. But...do my prayers even reach the Goddess when my powers have yet to awaken?

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Queen of Hyrule
rows.description: When I first saw a hot-footed frog at Hopper Pond, I couldn't take my eyes off of it. I came here every day to observe it. Mother's face grew stiff when I showed her the frog, though she never expressed outward disdain for them. She probably didn't want to speak poorly of something I liked.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Queen of Hyrule
rows.description: Rito fabrics are high quality, making them popular at the Exchange. Mother adored this store and special ordered this coat—it is made with the finest of down feathers. It fits me so perfectly that it feels as though it were custom made for me. To think, I am the same height as Mother now... It brings up such feelings in me...

rows.description: A special mask for members of the Gerudo Secret Club. Painted with dye made from crushed luminous stones, it gives off a lurid, mysterious glow in the dark.

rows.subject: Rauru
rows.description: It is said that Hyrule Forest Park began with a single tree planted by the first king and queen of Hyrule. Since then, a tree has been planted each time the throne is succeeded, and now they make up this thriving woodland.

rows.subject: Ravio's Hood
rows.description: The hood of a traveling merchant who had a bracelet that could turn the wearer into a painting. Wearing it increases your sideways climbing speed. It's a rather rare find.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Revali
rows.description: Divine Beast Vah Medoh seems to be soaring easily through the air. Training must be going well. Among all of the Divine Beasts, I am told that Medoh, controlled by air currents, is the most challenging to maneuver. Yet Revali continues to impress. I imagine he, with his strong sense of duty and work ethic, has trained more than anyone else.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Revali
rows.description: I've heard that the Rito use refined group tactics in combat. Their elder has incredible intellect—the sharpest among the Rito, in fact. And Revali is said to be the strongest Rito in history. It is said that they're an iron-clad force unlike any ever witnessed. I even sensed remarkable composure from the elder as he told us not to worry about them. It was reassuring.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Revali
rows.description: Watching him practice here at the Flight Range, it is clear to me that he is a truly unique Champion. He creates an updraft and then catches it, soaring upward rapidly. He is the only one capable of such a feat, and yet it isn't even what makes him so remarkable.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Revali
rows.description: Revali brought me to Goflam's Secret Hot Spring, telling me I was overworking myself. Since he can only carry one person, he said he would act as my guard, so Link is waiting at the village. I cannot remember the last time I relaxed on my own like this...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Revali's Champion Garb
rows.description: The Kochi Dye Shop is considered without peer all across Hyrule. The owner, too, is without peer... I brought five garments here to have them dyed using the shop's special technique, and a unique royal-blue color was achieved by taking extracts from a silent princess. I wonder if everyone will appreciate them.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Rito
rows.description: With the Rito and Gerudo coming here to offer up specialty wares from across Hyrule, Maritta Exchange is always a lively place. In particular, the fish being sold here are popular among Rito and Gerudo alike—they sell out almost immediately.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Rito
rows.description: The winged inhabitants of this land call Rito Village their home. The wind currents facilitate upward mobility throughout its vertical design, allowing the Rito to fly from one area to another with ease. Additionally, platforms were originally constructed to connect the areas for other peoples, but it seems even the Rito are using them more and more.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Rito
rows.description: It tends to be their fabrics that garner attention, but the Rito have the best woodworking techniques in Hyrule, as well. From their serving dishes to their structures, even the very framework of their village, the Rito have made everything from wood. I'm told the way they transport lumber midair is quite the sight, and I'd love to see it someday.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Rito
rows.description: I've heard that the Rito use refined group tactics in combat. Their elder has incredible intellect—the sharpest among the Rito, in fact. And Revali is said to be the strongest Rito in history. It is said that they're an iron-clad force unlike any ever witnessed. I even sensed remarkable composure from the elder as he told us not to worry about them. It was reassuring.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Rito Stable
rows.description: The proprietor was proud to tell me that, of all of them, Rito Stable boasts the oldest history. He also shared that no matter what price was offered, he would never sell it. His passion for this place will surely be carried on through his family line.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Rito Village
rows.description: This stone pillar towers overheard in the center of the village. It occurred to me that it may be Medoh's perch...and a frightful image sprang to mind, one of the pillar crumbling beneath the weight of Medoh. However, this Divine Beast is far lighter than it appears as compared to the others. My concerns, ultimately, are unfounded.

rows.subject: Roasted Food
rows.description: When I dropped an apple here, it wasn't long before it became a baked apple. After that, I tried my hand at grilling some meat and fish in the same way. I found it rather convenient, without need of a pot or a fire. Although, one Goron watched me curiously. I imagine it must've been an unusual sight for him—after all, they primarily feast upon rocks.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Robbie
rows.description: It has been decided that we will investigate ancient Sheikah ruins in preparation for the Calamity. The entrance to the Royal Ancient Lab, which we were forbidden from opening, now stands open. Things such as blueprints still remain, and Purah and Robbie have been absorbed in reading them, sparing no time for sleep.

rows.description: This frog statue is the guardian of travelers, though I don't believe anyone knows why it's a frog, specifically... It is fascinating that a group as technologically advanced as the Sheikah would still believe in such symbols of good fortune. Maybe it somehow relates to when the Sheikah splintered after a disagreement regarding the royal family... A symbol of hope to one day reunite, perhaps?

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Royal Family of Hyrule
rows.description: It is said that Hyrule Forest Park began with a single tree planted by the first king and queen of Hyrule. Since then, a tree has been planted each time the throne is succeeded, and now they make up this thriving woodland.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Royal Family of Hyrule
rows.description: Hyrule Castle was here on the Great Plateau in ancient times and is still under the protection of the kingdom. Father has decreed that the people are free to worship at the Temple of Time. Barring that, however, only the royal family may enter here. I imagine that is because the royal family still has many connections to this area.

rows.subject: Royal Guard Boots
rows.description: This spiffy cap is part of the uniform for Hyrule's Royal Guard. It's lighter than it looks and easy to move around in. It's a rather rare find.

rows.subject: Royal Guard Cap
rows.description: These boots are part of the uniform for Hyrule's Royal Guard. They're a fine blend of style and function and a rather rare find.

rows.subject: Royal Guard Set
rows.description: The official uniform of the royal guards who protected the royal family of Hyrule. Accompanying the king meant attending formal functions, so it blends both styles and function. It is light and easy to move around in.

rows.subject: Royal Guard Uniform
rows.description: The dignified uniform for Hyrule's Royal Guard. It's made of lightweight materials and is both stylish and practical. It's a rather rare find.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Royal Palace
rows.description: Chief Urbosa has made the decision to offer the Gerudo's support in subduing the Calamity. She and I have been close friends for a long time now, but the conversation leading to this decision was the first time we spoke as formal representatives of our people. She is as transparent as always in her motivations: to protect those she cares for. And this is also why she is so trustworthy.

rows.description: This armor has built-in electricity resistance thanks to its source material—an ancient marvel called "rubber." Such technology does not exist in this modern age.

rows.subject: Rupee
rows.description: Cotera is worshipped as the goddess of the land, and the villagers' offerings to her tend to be vegetables rather than rupees. It sounds like she's been less lively due to a decrease in rupee donations lately. Self-sufficiency is taking root in Kakariko Village, so perhaps fewer people see the value in rupees...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Sacred Ground Ruins
rows.description: This is a sacred place. Once, Daruk suggested I re-create a ceremony believed to have been held here in the past, the knighting ceremony for the one wielding the sword that seals the darkness. It...did not go well. Urbosa tells me I should look the knight in the eye rather than looking at the sword, but whenever I try, I simply...can't.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Safula Hill
rows.description: The area around Sanidin Park is a vast grassland, making it Hyrule's finest habitat for horses. The white horses of the royal family have been bred for generations, but I heard that the very first generation was born here. Apparently, there are still white horses around this area.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Sage of Water
rows.description: Divine Beast Vah Ruta is named after the Zora sage. I wonder if it was submerged in water by the king of Hyrule when the reservoir was made. In any case, I have heard that its trunk, capable of releasing vast amounts of water, lowered when Mipha approached—a clear invitation for her, almost as though it was an old friend.

The Gerudo use them as a means of transportation; however, they are quite difficult to handle. Without Urbosa's training, I might never have been able to maneuver one.

rows.description: There are only two cherry blossom trees in Hyrule. They have been referred to as the Father Tree and Mother Tree. I imagine this is because the cherry blossom trees are sometimes worshipped for their supposed ability to purge evil spirits. Satori, who is said to live on this mountain, may be a protector of Mother Tree, sent by Father Tree.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Scimitar of the Seven
rows.description: Among other things, the Gerudo are known for their craft in jewelry. They consider the gems used in their jewelry as talismans, absorbing both sunlight and moonlight, which cleanses evil. As such, they wear the jewelry as much as possible. Even Urbosa's shield and knife have been crafted by a jeweler rather than a blacksmith.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Scorching Climate
rows.description: Just beyond the Maw of Death Mountain is a scorching region. The heat from the flow of lava can be intense—so intense, in fact, that it can take one's life should they fail to prepare accordingly. My bodyguards forbade me from going any farther, yet it is my duty to keep a close watch on the Divine Beasts we will be fighting alongside. This mission proves to be exceedingly dangerous...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Scorching Climate
rows.description: Goron City is watched over by Daruk, chief of the Gorons. Despite coming equipped with fireproof elixir, I didn't quite bring enough of it. I settled on making more myself, but I was having trouble catching fireproof lizards. The Gorons, seeing my struggle, decided to help me, and well...now I have enough fireproof elixir to last the rest of my life.

rows.description: The beds in the Zora inn are hard and apparently quite unpopular among travelers. The owner consulted with me about it, saying that since Zora sleep in the water, they aren't sure what makes a bed good or bad. I offered a suggestion of creating a bed that's akin to floating in water. That may have been too unrealistic...

rows.subject: Serenne Stable
rows.description: I've been told the people of Serenne Stable just moved here, hence the many wooden boxes all around. Originally, stables were started up by nomadic people who would host travelers—it seems the tents at these stables are a relic of such times. Nowadays, stables stay put, so finding a mobile one such as this is a rare thing.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Seres Scablands
rows.description: The origin of the Dragon's Blood tree's name is unknown. At one time, the water from the surrounding mountains flowed into a network of rivers on this plateau. Perhaps the water itself was likened to bleeding—the network of blood vessels, and over time, it came to be associated with dragons. Thus, the current name.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Shadow Hamlet
rows.description: The Shadow Hamlet is a secluded village where people prefer to live somewhat disconnected from the rest of society. Many in Hyrule do not even know this place exists. I at least knew the name, but I had no idea it would be like this. I came to warn the people here about the Calamity, but they turned me away...

rows.description: The Zora use Shatterback Point as an area to demonstrate their courage. I understand this was once a crowded and lively place—many young people came to test their mettle. But ever since a Lynel took residence in the mountain, no one dares go near. No one except Sidon, I fear. Mipha expressly told him not to go, but he got a look in his eye when she did...

rows.subject: Sheikah
rows.description: For generations, the Sheikah have lived in Kakariko Village. The town has been their refuge ever since they were banished from Hyrule—their advanced technology was viewed as a threat. The village itself is nestled in the mountains, as an intentional hiding place. I imagine it feels as a haven to them...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Sheikah
rows.description: Impa will be the next elder. I am thrilled to see her take up the mantle. At present, she is the royal advisor, however, and is responsible for the internal investigation of the Divine Beasts. As such, she implored the current elder to wait until her work with the investigation is complete, after which she will officially step into her new role.

Now that recent investigations into the Divine Beasts have revealed that this shrine was built in preparation against the Calamity, however, we should move forward with its study.

Perhaps they sense the evil spirit of the Calamity...

It's flooded with travelers, and the innkeeps seem exhausted. Once the Calamity is behind us, one of the first orders of business will be repairing the bridge.

rows.subject: Sonia
rows.description: It is said that Hyrule Forest Park began with a single tree planted by the first king and queen of Hyrule. Since then, a tree has been planted each time the throne is succeeded, and now they make up this thriving woodland.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Sonia
rows.description: Royal princesses have a sacred power, which is claimed to have been passed down generation after generation. In fact, the lineage traces all the way back to the first queen, when Hyrule was founded. The ritual at the Temple of Time falls upon the princess to carry out. But...do my prayers even reach the Goddess when my powers have yet to awaken?

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: South Akkala Stable
rows.description: At Purah's urging, South Akkala Stable was built. It seems she gave the stable owners many sheep to celebrate the opening, so now the grounds are filled with them. There are more sheep than there are horses here. I have to wonder...why sheep?

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Spring of Courage
rows.description: I have come to this spring countless times since I was young to receive the protection of Farore, Goddess of Courage. Despite that, my sealing power has yet to be awakened... But soon I will turn 17. I'm certain that if I train on Mount Lanayru, that will change things...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Spring of Power
rows.description: This is the spring where Din, Goddess of Power, is worshipped. Once she was one of the Three Goddesses, alongside Courage and Wisdom, but it is said that faith in her dimmed due to power being seen as a symbol of the Demon King. The terrain around the spring is complex and covered with roughly chopped trees, suggesting this place was once used as a training site of some kind.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Spring of Wisdom
rows.description: This is the spring where Nayru, Goddess of Wisdom, is worshipped. "Those younger than 17 lack wisdom and are forbidden from entering the mountain." Hm. Today, all I can do is look up at it, but tomorrow, I climb Mount Lanayru. If my sealing power doesn't awaken... No...it will. I'm certain it will be fine.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Stable
rows.description: Here in Goponga Village, they're working to make it possible to manage horses with just a few people. This would be achievable by using the small islands scattered about Lanayru Wetlands as stables. There's a grassy field at the village's entrance where the horses seem to be living at ease. And the villagers here even told me my white horse is beautiful.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Stable
rows.description: I've been told the people of Serenne Stable just moved here, hence the many wooden boxes all around. Originally, stables were started up by nomadic people who would host travelers—it seems the tents at these stables are a relic of such times. Nowadays, stables stay put, so finding a mobile one such as this is a rare thing.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Starlight Memories
rows.description: Among other things, the Gerudo are known for their craft in jewelry. They consider the gems used in their jewelry as talismans, absorbing both sunlight and moonlight, which cleanses evil. As such, they wear the jewelry as much as possible. Even Urbosa's shield and knife have been crafted by a jeweler rather than a blacksmith.

rows.subject: Tabantha Great Bridge
rows.description: The bridge on the south side of Tanagar Canyon is closed because of deterioration, which means the travelers coming and going from Hebra are funneling here to Snowfield Stable. It's flooded with travelers, and the innkeeps seem exhausted. Once the Calamity is behind us, one of the first orders of business will be repairing the bridge.

rows.description: Year after year, more villagers depart from Tabantha Village, never to return. It seems the bitter cold is challenging company. Now there are few who live here and lines of empty homes. Many of the people who work at Snowfield Stable are originally from here.

Perhaps the Goddess Statue was enshrined here as a means of preventing further damage. Although, I wonder... Is this place instead protected because of the Goddess Statue's presence?

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Temple of Time
rows.description: Hyrule Castle was here on the Great Plateau in ancient times and is still under the protection of the kingdom. Father has decreed that the people are free to worship at the Temple of Time. Barring that, however, only the royal family may enter here. I imagine that is because the royal family still has many connections to this area.

rows.subject: The Noble Canteen
rows.description: The Noble Canteen's famous cocktail is known as the Noble Pursuit. Gerudo preparing to seek the voe of their dreams drink it for good luck. I wanted to partake in one but was told that I'm not ready for it yet...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Throne Room
rows.description: The throne room sits at the center of the castle and is the site of many official events. Father would take the throne to the left, and Mother, the one on the right. Her throne remains unchanged and untouched since her passing.

rows.subject: Thunder Helm
rows.description: A precious heirloom passed down among the Gerudo. It deflects lightning strikes and is traditionally worn only by the Gerudo chief.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Thundra Plateau
rows.description: The origin of the Dragon's Blood tree's name is unknown. At one time, the water from the surrounding mountains flowed into a network of rivers on this plateau. Perhaps the water itself was likened to bleeding—the network of blood vessels, and over time, it came to be associated with dragons. Thus, the current name.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Thyphlo Ruins
rows.description: The existence of a shrine has been confirmed here at Thyphlo Ruins. Could that darkness act as a test to the one chosen by the sword that seals the darkness? I don't think I can go much farther, however. I wonder if I will have to ask him to come investigate? No, I don't want to have to rely on him for this.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Traveler's Guardian Deity
rows.description: This frog statue is the guardian of travelers, though I don't believe anyone knows why it's a frog, specifically... It is fascinating that a group as technologically advanced as the Sheikah would still believe in such symbols of good fortune. Maybe it somehow relates to when the Sheikah splintered after a disagreement regarding the royal family... A symbol of hope to one day reunite, perhaps?

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Traveling Merchant
rows.description: Trade with Gerudo Town is going well, but apparently there is no end to the traveling merchants meeting with disaster in the canyon. Though the Gerudo may be accustomed to the road, it is a difficult one for Hylians. I'll speak with Father about whether we can have a stable built here.

rows.description: Occasionally while out fishing, the fishers will find treasure chests that have sunken to the ocean floor. They enjoy playing a game wherein they attempt to guess the chest's contents. Everyone who plays takes the game quite seriously, as the rules include that guessing correctly means that person keeps whatever is inside the chest.

The custom is to climb in total silence, and upon reaching the top, pray as the sun dips below the horizon. I set out to climb the mountain myself, but I was stopped by Link who observed how very steep it is. Personally, I feel he was being overly cautious.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Updraft
rows.description: Watching him practice here at the Flight Range, it is clear to me that he is a truly unique Champion. He creates an updraft and then catches it, soaring upward rapidly. He is the only one capable of such a feat, and yet it isn't even what makes him so remarkable.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Urbosa
rows.description: Gerudo Canyon provides the only path leading to Gerudo Town. It seems monsters have made the former quarry into their base, and even the Gerudo, who are intimately familiar with the land, stay exclusively on the main road. Urbosa warned me countless times to exercise the utmost caution when traveling through here.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Urbosa
rows.subjectDisplayName: Those Who Reside in the Desert
rows.description: Here in Gerudo Desert, the temperatures vary wildly—enough so to be life threatening. In addition, traveling across the sand by foot is challenging. These conditions certainly explain the strength of body and spirit that the Gerudo possess. Which has me thinking... While Mother was prone to illness, she would often visit here, despite the harsh environment...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Urbosa
rows.description: Kara Kara Bazaar serves as a trading post for those who cannot enter Gerudo Town. It's a smart thing, since the town only allows women to enter. Urbosa warned me to be on alert for the Yiga Clan here, but I cannot imagine they would attack in a place as crowded as this. She worries a bit too much.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Urbosa
rows.description: Gerudo Town is ruled over by Urbosa and is also the largest oasis in the desert. The buildings look as if they were carved out of large boulders—quite sturdy indeed. When your home is a desert with numerous dangers, having strong walls is a sure way to stay safe.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Urbosa
rows.description: Chief Urbosa has made the decision to offer the Gerudo's support in subduing the Calamity. She and I have been close friends for a long time now, but the conversation leading to this decision was the first time we spoke as formal representatives of our people. She is as transparent as always in her motivations: to protect those she cares for. And this is also why she is so trustworthy.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Urbosa
rows.description: The sand seals—which I understand to have evolved from an aquatic creature of some kind—reside only in Gerudo and move through the desert as if swimming. The Gerudo use them as a means of transportation; however, they are quite difficult to handle. Without Urbosa's training, I might never have been able to maneuver one.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Urbosa
rows.description: Among other things, the Gerudo are known for their craft in jewelry. They consider the gems used in their jewelry as talismans, absorbing both sunlight and moonlight, which cleanses evil. As such, they wear the jewelry as much as possible. Even Urbosa's shield and knife have been crafted by a jeweler rather than a blacksmith.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Urbosa
rows.description: This is a sacred place. Once, Daruk suggested I re-create a ceremony believed to have been held here in the past, the knighting ceremony for the one wielding the sword that seals the darkness. It...did not go well. Urbosa tells me I should look the knight in the eye rather than looking at the sword, but whenever I try, I simply...can't.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Urbosa's Champion Garb
rows.description: The Kochi Dye Shop is considered without peer all across Hyrule. The owner, too, is without peer... I brought five garments here to have them dyed using the shop's special technique, and a unique royal-blue color was achieved by taking extracts from a silent princess. I wonder if everyone will appreciate them.

rows.subject: Vah Medoh's Perch
rows.description: This stone pillar towers overheard in the center of the village. It occurred to me that it may be Medoh's perch...and a frightful image sprang to mind, one of the pillar crumbling beneath the weight of Medoh. However, this Divine Beast is far lighter than it appears as compared to the others. My concerns, ultimately, are unfounded.
