rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Vegetable
rows.description: Cotera is worshipped as the goddess of the land, and the villagers' offerings to her tend to be vegetables rather than rupees. It sounds like she's been less lively due to a decrease in rupee donations lately. Self-sufficiency is taking root in Kakariko Village, so perhaps fewer people see the value in rupees...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Ventest Clothing Boutique
rows.description: There is a sign out front that reads "Ventest Clothing Boutique," though this is partially covering the sign's original wording, "East Wind." Inside the shop, traditional Hyrulean clothing and colorful, Hateno-dyed modern clothing is lined up as if in competition with the other. Apparently, the current owner and their predecessor are at odds about differences in the shop's direction. I was pressed about which clothing was better and promptly fled.

rows.subject: Warm Doublet
rows.description: A warm pullover typically worn by mountain folk. Its sturdy fabric and thick gloves are great at retaining body heat.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Warm Doublet
rows.description: From here, you can see the Great Plateau—or rather, Hyrule itself. At the castle, we are king and princess, but while here, we were father and daughter. It was in this place that I learned about everything from paragliders to cooking... I still remember the feeling of the warm doublet Father wrapped around my shoulders...

rows.subject: Well-Worn Outfit
rows.description: These old clothes were left in the shrine of resurrection for Link by those who placed him there a century ago. They have become a bit tattered after so much time.

rows.subject: Well-Worn Trousers
rows.description: These old trousers are threadbare in spots, but they're surprisingly comfortable. The legs are a bit too short, though.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Wetland Stable
rows.description: Father decided that the stables would be places of refuge in preparation for the Calamity. In his words, "There is more to protecting our people than simply fighting." The Stable Association was thus established to further strengthen cooperation, and Mestro, proprietor of Wetland Stable, was appointed as its first chairman.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: White Horse
rows.description: Here in Goponga Village, they're working to make it possible to manage horses with just a few people. This would be achievable by using the small islands scattered about Lanayru Wetlands as stables. There's a grassy field at the village's entrance where the horses seem to be living at ease. And the villagers here even told me my white horse is beautiful.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: White Horse
rows.description: The area around Sanidin Park is a vast grassland, making it Hyrule's finest habitat for horses. The white horses of the royal family have been bred for generations, but I heard that the very first generation was born here. Apparently, there are still white horses around this area.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Woodland Stable
rows.description: The proprietor of Woodland Stable was deeply moved by how beautifully ornamented Mother's horse was and is now studying techniques for adorning them himself. He even braided my horse's mane to match my own braids. Mother's care for horses lives on, in this way. It fills me with joy to see it.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Yiga Clan
rows.description: Kara Kara Bazaar serves as a trading post for those who cannot enter Gerudo Town. It's a smart thing, since the town only allows women to enter. Urbosa warned me to be on alert for the Yiga Clan here, but I cannot imagine they would attack in a place as crowded as this. She worries a bit too much.

rows.subject: Zant's Helmet
rows.description: The ruthless Usurper King of the Twilight Realm wore a helmet much like this one... It's a rather rare find.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Zelda's Winter Clothes
rows.description: Rito fabrics are high quality, making them popular at the Exchange. Mother adored this store and special ordered this coat—it is made with the finest of down feathers. It fits me so perfectly that it feels as though it were custom made for me. To think, I am the same height as Mother now... It brings up such feelings in me...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Zora
rows.description: These stone monuments erected along this path detail the history of the Zora in King Dorephan's words. Thus far, only three have been made, but once the rest are completed, travelers will be able to learn even more about the Zora.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Zora
rows.description: The land of the Zora, known as Zora's Domain, is home to the Champion Mipha and the guardians of the Great Spring. We have a long history of cultural exchange with them, dating back even further than ten thousand years ago. This promenade is a testament to that long standing relationship between the Zora and Hyrule.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Zora
rows.description: King Dorephan rules over the Zora and is father to Mipha. He's known for his incredible strength—in fact, he fights with his fins rather than wielding a weapon. One of the guards here even told me excitedly about an army of monsters who were eradicated with a single blow from the king.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Zora
rows.description: The stone architecture and metal engravings of the Zora are astonishing. Truly, the village itself is a work of art. The Zora made the buildings, furniture, and even the books out of a water-resistant ore. Technology such as this could be developed only by the Zora.

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Zora
rows.description: The beds in the Zora inn are hard and apparently quite unpopular among travelers. The owner consulted with me about it, saying that since Zora sleep in the water, they aren't sure what makes a bed good or bad. I offered a suggestion of creating a bed that's akin to floating in water. That may have been too unrealistic...

rows.page: Voice Memories in Breath of the Wild
rows.subject: Zora
rows.description: The Zora use Shatterback Point as an area to demonstrate their courage. I understand this was once a crowded and lively place—many young people came to test their mettle. But ever since a Lynel took residence in the mountain, no one dares go near. No one except Sidon, I fear. Mipha expressly told him not to go, but he got a look in his eye when she did...

rows.subject: Zora's Domain
rows.description: This depiction of Mipha is truly exquisite, though that is hardly surprising—Zora's Domain is home to talented metalworking artisans, after all. It is said that this statue was made not only to honor her elevation as a Champion, but also to act as a beacon for her safety, in the hopes that she will return home. She was embarrassed by it, however, and has asked King Dorephan to move it somewhere less prominent once she completes her duty.
